notes.meaning: God hates cheating in business, such as using rigged scales to trick buyers. In biblical times, merchants weighed silver and goods using stone weights, and God delights when those weights are completely fair. True devotion to God always shows itself in daily honesty toward other people.

Proud people think too highly of themselves, but their arrogance quickly brings disgrace and embarrassment. In contrast, humble people recognize their limitations and are willing to learn from God and others. Because the lowly remain teachable, they gain true wisdom and avoid the fall that pride causes.

Honest people are led along a safe and clear path by their sincerity and moral integrity. Those who are crooked and unfaithful hide malicious plans, which ends up destroying their lives. Sincere obedience protects a person, while double-dealing brings self-inflicted ruin.

Great fortunes cannot buy protection when God's day of judgment arrives. Money is completely useless against divine wrath and cannot buy off death. Only righteousness—being right with God and living justly—delivers the soul from ultimate destruction.

Living an upright and blameless life smooths out difficulties and keeps a person on an even road. In contrast, wicked people stumble and collapse under the weight of their own bad choices. God makes the path straight for those who walk with a clean conscience.

Upright living rescues good people from traps and sudden dangers. Faithless people, however, are captured and ruined by their own uncontrolled, greedy cravings. The very sins they desire become the net that holds them fast.

When a wicked person dies, all their earthly dreams, plans, and ambitions vanish forever. Any confidence placed in wealth, human influence, or mortal strength is cut short by the grave. Unbelievers lose every earthly hope the moment their life ends.

God often rescues the righteous person out of deep trouble and distress just in time. The wicked person then falls into the very danger or hardship they intended for others. God sets His people free while justice catches up with the wrongdoer.

Godless people use flattering words, lies, and slander to ruin the reputation and faith of their neighbors. But righteous people use godly knowledge and spiritual discernment to see through the deception and escape harm. God's truth protects the faithful from corrupt talk.

An entire city rejoices when honest and godly citizens prosper and lead well. Likewise, people shout with relief when corrupt and oppressive individuals are removed from power. The moral character of its citizens directly shapes the happiness of a community.

Faithful citizens lift up their community through earnest prayers, good counsel, and honest lives. In contrast, foul language, curses, and wicked schemes from corrupt people tear a city down. God blesses towns where the upright seek the good of others.

A person who lacks good sense openly insults and looks down on their neighbor. A wise and understanding person knows when to stay silent instead of stirring up conflict. Holding one's tongue prevents unnecessary hurt and shows true self-control.

Gossips wander around trading in private stories and betraying the trust of others. A reliable and faithful friend keeps private matters confidential to protect the person involved. Keeping a confidence preserves peace and honors true friendship.

Without sound leadership and guidance, a nation or community collapses like a ship without a pilot. Having many wise advisers provides safety and helps leaders make balanced decisions. Good leaders seek broad counsel before taking big steps.

Promising to pay the debts of a stranger brings sudden financial trouble and regret. A person who avoids rash financial guarantees keeps their household secure and peaceful. It is foolish to endanger your family's future for someone you do not know.

A gracious and godly woman wins lasting respect and honor for her character. Ruthless or violent men may amass riches, but that wealth is fleeting compared to true honor. A gentle spirit earns a good name that lasts longer than money.

Being kind and generous brings health and peace to a person's own soul. But cruel, hard-hearted people make themselves miserable and bring trouble on their own bodies. Our attitudes toward others naturally rebound on ourselves.

Wicked work yields deceitful wages that quickly fade and fail to satisfy. But anyone who sows seeds of righteousness is sure to reap a lasting and true reward. Doing good is like planting good seed that brings a dependable harvest.

Genuine righteousness naturally leads toward life and lasting peace. But chasing after evil leads straight toward misery and death. What we pursue each day determines the kind of end we will experience.

The Lord detests people with crooked, deceitful, and hypocritical hearts. However, He takes great delight in those whose daily walk is blameless and sincere. God looks past outward appearances to see what is hidden inside.

Wicked people can join forces and make alliances, but they will never escape God's punishment. Meanwhile, the children of the righteous will find rescue and safety. No human strength can shield wrongdoers when God's justice moves.

Physical beauty without good judgment and modesty is completely out of place. It is like putting an expensive gold ring into the snout of a pig wallowing in the mud. Outward charm loses all its value when inner character is missing.

Righteous people desire things that bring blessing, peace, and goodness to everyone. The hopes of wicked people, however, only bring divine wrath and disappointment. In the end, God rewards the good desires of His people and cuts down evil hopes.

Some people give generously to others and find their wealth growing even more. Others hoard tightly what they ought to share, only to end up in unexpected poverty. God blesses an open hand and withholds blessing from stingy hearts.

A generous person will prosper, because God replenishes those who share with others. Whoever refreshes people in need will find themselves refreshed by God's kindness. Giving to others never empties us of what God can supply.

People curse a merchant who hoards grain during hard times to drive prices up. But blessings pour over anyone who sells food fairly so neighbors do not starve. Using necessities to exploit people invites the anger of both man and God.

Anyone who eagerly searches for ways to do good wins the favor of God and people. But whoever goes looking for trouble and mischief will find that evil boomerangs back on them. What we seek for others usually turns out to be what we find for ourselves.

Those who rely on their money for safety will wither and fall like autumn leaves. But righteous people will flourish and stay green like healthy tree branches. Trusting God gives life, while trusting wealth leads to disappointment.

Anyone who mistreats their family through greed, bad temper, or foolish spending ends up with nothing but the wind. A foolish manager soon loses everything and ends up serving the wise. Managing our home with care protects our future.

The life and influence of a godly person feed others like a tree of life. A wise person attracts and wins souls by leading them toward God and what is right. Good words and examples nourish the spiritual life of everyone nearby.

If even godly people face God's discipline on earth when they do wrong, sinners will certainly receive their due punishment. God does not overlook sin in anyone. Unrepentant wrongdoers cannot expect to escape the consequences of their choices.
